title: Greenbrix C4: What a private mortgage really costs
topic: Private first and second mortgages: What a private mortgage really costs
hook: What a private mortgage really costs. No fine print.
logline: Seven-slide Greenbrix Capital carousel for Krystian Catala: What a private mortgage really costs.
structure: 7 slides: loupe reading 'NO FINE PRINT' on the receipt, rate, lender fee, broker fee, legal and appraisal, receipt vs the alternative (lost deposit, power of sale, 20% cards), TOTAL slip stamped IN WRITING with Krystian. Loupe handle crosses the 1-2 seam.
device: a thermal cost statement that prints one line per slide, hung from a printer slot, with a steel loupe doing real optical magnification of the newest line; a brick meter COSTS LISTED 1/4 to 4/4 and a TOTAL, FULL TERM line that stays blank until the CTA stamp IN WRITING
lessons: Three yellow placeholders must be filled by the client before posting: [X% to Y%] private rate range, [X%] lender fee, [How Greenbrix charges] broker fee basis.
